summary: Implemented print_json across rich: JSON renderable (rich/json.py, with __main__ CLI), JSONHighlighter in rich/highlighter.py, six json.* theme keys in rich/default_styles.py, Console.print_json after print in rich/console.py, package-level print_json in rich/__init__.py. Added tests test_print_json (tests/test_console.py) and test_rich_print_json (tests/test_rich_print.py), docs (console.rst section, reference/json.rst, reference.rst toctree), and a CHANGELOG Unreleased entry. Nothing was run or committed. The expected ANSI string in test_print_json was derived by hand and is unverified; the number regex does not add a trailing \b, unlike the reference.
